sky-beach.name: Sky Beach
sky-beach.building: The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon · King Power Mahanakhon
sky-beach.intro: End the day with Bangkok spread out around you at Sky Beach. At this open-air bar on top of Mahanakhon Tower, you can enjoy cocktails and American-style bites while looking over the buildings and city lights. Bring friends who enjoy DJ music for an evening with both a skyline and a soundtrack. Arrive before sunset to see the daytime city turn into a night panorama.

facts.children: All ages welcome, according to the hotel’s official FAQ
facts.booking: Admission and seating are first come, first served; use the King Power Mahanakhon main entrance

reasons.title: From daytime towers to city lights
reasons.text: Look out across Bangkok in every direction. In daylight, follow the buildings and roads through the city; after dark, watch it fill with lights. It is a good place for photographs with friends or to take in the broad city views with family.

reasons.title: Cocktails and DJ music to close the day
reasons.text: Enjoy a cocktail and American-style bites with DJ music. After sightseeing, leave time to talk about the trip with friends while looking over the city at night. Admission and seats are first come, first served, so do not arrive expecting a reserved place.

sky-beach.menu: Pair American-style bites with cocktails. Choose your favorite drinks with friends and take your time looking out over the city. The official information below includes the menu.
sky-beach.recommended: A good choice for friends who like DJ music and expansive city views, or for families who want to see Bangkok from above.
sky-beach.bestTime: Arrive before sunset to see the city and sky in daylight, then stay to watch Bangkok fill with lights after dark.
sky-beach.reservation: Admission and seating are first come, first served. Choose your companions and visiting time, then follow the on-site entry arrangements.
sky-beach.entrance: Enter through King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Drivers can use Mahanakhon Cube parking.
faq: Who is it good for?

Bring friends who enjoy DJ music and broad city views, or family members who want to look over Bangkok from above. The panorama stretches around the city: follow the buildings and roads in daylight, then watch the lights after dark. You can take photos with friends or share the wide views with your family.
Can children visit?
Yes. Families can visit without an age limit and enjoy the city views together. Admission and seating are first come, first served.
Can I visit late in the evening?

It opens daily from 10 a.m. to midnight, with last admission at 11 p.m. A late visit is possible, but arrive with time to spare if you want to enjoy the views and drinks rather than reaching the door at the last admission time.
Which entrance do I use?
Use King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. From BTS Chong Nonsi Exit 3, walk toward Mahanakhon, then follow the Sky Beach admission signs inside.

access.name: BTS Chong Nonsi
access.instructions: Leave BTS Chong Nonsi on the Silom Line through Exit 3 and walk toward King Power Mahanakhon. Enter through the main entrance and follow Sky Beach admission signs.

taxi.instructions: In Grab or Bolt, search for King Power Mahanakhon. If taking a taxi, show your driver the English or Thai directions below. On arrival, tell staff you are visiting Sky Beach.

hongs-sky-bar.name: HONG’s Sky Bar
hongs-sky-bar.building: InterContinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping · Rooftop
hongs-sky-bar.intro: Looking for somewhere to wind down in Chiang Mai? HONG’s Sky Bar has an outdoor terrace overlooking Doi Suthep and the city, with cocktails and Chinese sharing plates. Come before sunset with a partner or friends and spend time talking as the mountain backdrop gives way to the city lights.

facts.booking: Reserve through the hotel’s official booking page. Reservations may be canceled if you arrive 15 minutes late.
facts.rain: The bar may close in rain or bad weather.
facts.address: 153 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand

reasons.title: From sunset to the city lights
reasons.text: Arrive before sunset if you want to see Doi Suthep. Talk with your companions while looking over the mountain and town, then enjoy the illuminated city after dark. Following a busy day of sightseeing, this is a chance to slow down and see a different side of Chiang Mai.

reasons.title: Cocktails and Chinese plates to share
reasons.text: Pair cocktails featuring Thai honey, lemongrass and Chiang Mai tea with Chinese sharing plates. It suits a light drink and several dishes with friends or a partner. Because the bar is outdoors, rain or bad weather can close it; keep another dinner plan in mind if rain is forecast.

hongs-sky-bar.menu: Cocktails feature Thai honey, lemongrass and Chiang Mai tea, alongside Chinese sharing plates. A bao bun and selected drink set costs 550 baht net daily from 4–9 p.m. On weekdays from 5–7 p.m., selected cocktails and wines are buy one, get one. Check whether your preferred drink is part of the offer when ordering.
hongs-sky-bar.recommended: Come with friends or a partner for cocktails and Chiang Mai’s evening views. Watching Doi Suthep give way to the city lights makes an unhurried setting for conversation after sightseeing.
hongs-sky-bar.bestTime: Arrive before sunset and leave time to enjoy both Doi Suthep and the city lights.
hongs-sky-bar.budget: A bao bun with a selected drink costs 550 baht net. Consider the set for a light meal and drink between 4 and 9 p.m.; extra food and drinks are ordered separately.
faq: Who should I visit with?
It suits friends or a partner who want cocktails with Chiang Mai’s evening views. You can look out toward Doi Suthep, then watch the city lights, leaving time to talk after a day of sightseeing.
When can I see both mountains and city lights?
Arrive before sunset. You can see Doi Suthep and the town in daylight, then enjoy the lights in the evening. Rather than leaving straight after a quick look, take your time over cocktails and food.
What if I am late for a reservation?
Your reservation may be canceled if you arrive 15 minutes after the booked time. Leave a little room in your sightseeing and travel plans so you can start the evening without rushing.
Does it open in the rain?

The bar may close in rain or bad weather. Clear conditions make it easier to enjoy the mountain and city views from the outdoor terrace. If rain is forecast, check whether the bar is operating before leaving.

taxi.instructions: In Grab or Bolt, search for 153 Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand. If taking a taxi, show your driver the English or Thai directions below. On arrival, tell staff you are visiting HONG’s Sky Bar.

baba-nest.name: Baba Nest
baba-nest.intro: For an evening spent watching the sea as the sun goes down in Phuket, consider Baba Nest. The infinity pool surrounding Sri Panwa’s outdoor deck opens toward the Andaman Sea and nearby islands. It suits an anniversary with a partner or cocktails with friends. This reservation-only bar operates from 5–8 p.m., so leave a dedicated evening for the sunset instead of squeezing it into a busy itinerary.

facts.minimumSpend: Hotel guests: 1,500 baht net per person; non-guests: 3,000 baht net per person. Required minimum spend to confirm the reservation.
facts.booking: Advance reservation required. Seats held for 15 minutes after the booked time; contact the venue beforehand if delayed.
facts.rain: Closes in rain. In bad weather, non-guests’ minimum spend can be transferred to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food.
facts.closed: Open daily without a regular closing day; closes in rain.
facts.address: 88 Moo 8, Sakdidej Road, Cape Panwa, Wichit, Phuket 83000, Thailand

reasons.title: An evening looking across the pool to the sea
reasons.text: Enjoy the view as the infinity pool around the deck seems to meet the water beyond. You can look across nearby islands and Phuket’s southeastern peninsula. Share a cocktail and watch the colors in the sky change for an evening to remember.

reasons.title: Take your time with cocktails and tapas
reasons.text: Pair cocktails, wine or champagne with Mexican tapas. This suits a day when you have time for drinks and scenery rather than a hurried dinner. Choose dishes with your partner or friends and linger over the sea view.

reasons.title: Plan around reservations and weather
reasons.text: Advance booking and a minimum spend apply. With opening hours from 5–8 p.m., plan for sunset rather than late-night drinks. The bar closes when it rains, so read the booking terms and weather before choosing your date.

baba-nest.menu: Cocktails, wine and champagne are served with Mexican tapas.
baba-nest.recommended: For travelers who enjoy sunset views over the sea and islands, or who are planning an anniversary evening.
baba-nest.bestTime: Open 5–8 p.m. Reserve for an evening enjoying the sea and sky around sunset.
baba-nest.budget: Minimum spend is 1,500 baht net per hotel guest and 3,000 baht net per non-guest. Read payment terms when booking so you do not confuse it with a separate admission fee.
baba-nest.reservation: Advance booking is required. Cancellation or a no-show incurs the full charge: 1,500 baht per hotel guest or 3,000 baht per non-guest. The non-guest minimum spend is nonrefundable; in bad weather it can be used at Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food.
faq: Do I need a reservation?

Yes. Choose a date with your companions and book in advance. Seats are held for 15 minutes after the reservation time, so finish other sightseeing with time to spare. Contact the venue beforehand if you expect to be late.
What is the minimum spend?

It is 1,500 baht net per hotel guest and 3,000 baht net per non-guest. This minimum is required to confirm the reservation, so include it in your cocktail and tapas budget. Read the payment terms when booking rather than treating it as a separate admission charge.
What happens if it rains?

Baba Nest closes when it rains. In bad weather, a non-guest’s minimum spend can be transferred for use at Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food. Read this condition before booking if the sea view and sunset are your main reason for visiting.
Can I visit late at night?
It opens daily from 5–8 p.m. Plan it as a sunset visit rather than a late-night bar stop, leaving time to settle in before sunset.

access.name: Sri Panwa Phuket
access.instructions: Search for Sri Panwa Phuket in Grab or Bolt. Ask staff for directions to Baba Nest when you arrive. Arrange your return transport as well if you plan to stay into the evening.

star-silavadee.name: STAR by Silavadee
star-silavadee.intro: Spend an evening overlooking the sea at STAR rooftop on Koh Samui. On top of Silavadee Pool Spa Resort, you can enjoy Western food and cocktails with views over Lamai Bay. Four sunken tables within the infinity pool are a distinctive seating option. Come for dinner with a partner or drinks and sea views with friends. Arriving early in the evening gives you time to see the water in daylight before continuing with a relaxed meal.

facts.address: 208/66 Moo 4, Maret, Koh Samui 84310, Thailand
facts.booking: Use Make a Reservation on the official venue page.

reasons.title: Start the evening overlooking Lamai Bay
reasons.text: The resort rooftop looks over Lamai Bay. Come early in the evening if you want to see the water in daylight. Start with a cocktail or wine, then continue with dinner and time by the sea with your companions.

reasons.title: Four tables set into the pool
reasons.text: Four tables sit low within the infinity pool. They are worth considering for a date with a distinctive seat as well as a sea view. Lounge beds and bar stools are available too; ask about your preferred seating when booking.

star-silavadee.menu: Western dinner dishes are served alongside cocktails and wine. Cocktails include Espresso Martini, Lychee Martini and Tom Yum Siam.
star-silavadee.recommended: For dinner with a partner and sea views, or cocktails and conversation with friends. Mention any preferred seat when booking to help plan your visit.
star-silavadee.bestTime: It opens at 5:30 p.m. Come early in the evening to see the sea in daylight before dinner. Leave time to share a cocktail overlooking Lamai Bay before your meal.
star-silavadee.seating: Four sunken pool tables, regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools are available, with 42 seats in total. Ask about your preferred seating when booking.
faq: Who is STAR good for?
It suits a partner who wants dinner overlooking the sea, or friends who want to talk about their trip over a cocktail. Choose it for an evening with Lamai Bay as the backdrop to your meal.
Can I sit at a pool table?
There are four sunken tables in the pool, along with regular dining seats, lounge beds and bar stools. Ask for your preferred seat when booking. The venue has 42 seats in total.
When can I enjoy both the sea view and dinner?

It opens at 5:30 p.m. Arrive early in the evening for daylight sea views, start with a cocktail and continue with dinner. Kitchen orders close at 10:30 p.m., so leave time for the meal when booking a late visit.
How do I reserve?
Select Make a Reservation on the official venue page. Choose your date and time with your companions, and ask about a pool table or any preferred seating when booking.
What should I wear?

The official reservation guidance specifies smart casual. Think of neat clothes for a dinner out: a collared shirt and pants for men, or a dress or blouse for women are useful examples. These gendered examples are packing suggestions, rather than extra venue rules.

access.name: Silavadee Resort

horizon-pattaya.name: Horizon Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
horizon-pattaya.intro: Make dinner part of your Pattaya vacation at Horizon. On Hilton Pattaya’s 34th floor, this rooftop restaurant combines views of Pattaya Bay with food and cocktails. It suits an anniversary with a partner or a dinner with parents somewhere with a view. Settle in around sunset and stay to see the colors of the sea and sky change as lights appear along the city.

facts.address: 333/101 Moo 9, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Pattaya, Chonburi 20260, Thailand
facts.booking: Select Horizon Book a Table on Hilton’s official Dining page.

reasons.title: Finish a beach day on the 34th floor
reasons.text: See the Pattaya beach you walked along during the day from above. The outdoor terrace opens across Pattaya Bay, and city lights follow the coastline after dark. It is a setting for cocktails and conversation about the day with your companions.

reasons.title: Stay for dinner as well as the view
reasons.text: The menu includes a seafood tower, tomahawk steak and lamb shank. An indoor dining room and outdoor terrace suit a meal with a view. For an anniversary or dinner with parents, leave enough time so you do not have to hurry to your next stop.

reasons.title: DJ music joins the evening view
reasons.text: A live DJ adds music in the evening. This suits a partner or friends who want views and music rather than a meal centered only on quiet conversation. If you hope to use the terrace, consider indoor seating as well in case of heat or rain.

horizon-pattaya.menu: The menu includes a seafood tower, Australian Angus tomahawk steak, slow-cooked lamb shank and snow fish with miso sauce.
horizon-pattaya.recommended: For travelers who want to add dinner with a view to a Pattaya beach vacation.
horizon-pattaya.bestTime: Come around sunset for changing colors across the sea and sky, or after dark for city lights.
horizon-pattaya.seating: Indoor seating and an outdoor terrace are available. Ask about terrace seating when booking if you would like to face the sea.
faq: Who should I visit with?
It suits a partner or parents for dinner with evening views. From the 34th floor of Hilton Pattaya, you can see both the sea and the city, making the meal a special part of the day.
When is the view best?
Come around sunset to watch the sea and sky change color. Stay for dinner to see the city lights appear too. If you want the terrace, mention your seating preference when booking.
What food is served?

Choices include a seafood tower, Australian Angus tomahawk steak, lamb shank and snow fish with miso sauce. Read the menu together and decide whether you want dinner or an evening focused on cocktails and views.
Where do I book?
Use Horizon’s Book a Table link on Hilton’s official Dining page. Choose your date with your companions, then select a dining time.

access.instructions: Search for Hilton Pattaya in Grab or Bolt. On arrival, ask hotel staff for directions to Horizon rooftop.

mahanakhon-skywalk.name: Mahanakhon SkyWalk
mahanakhon-skywalk.building: King Power Mahanakhon · Floor 74 indoor deck · Floor 78 outdoor observation deck
mahanakhon-skywalk.intro: See Bangkok in every direction from Mahanakhon SkyWalk. Explore the indoor observation deck on Floor 74 and outdoor deck on Floor 78, and look down through a glass floor 310 m above the city. A viewing point at 314 m is another highlight. Bring friends who enjoy landscape photography or family members curious about Bangkok from above. Allow time for both indoor and outdoor views, with a different perspective from each space.

facts.children: Child tickets are categorized for ages 8–12.
facts.address: 114 Narathiwas Ratchanakarin Road, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok
facts.booking: Choose a ticket for your visit date, time slot and age on the official ticket page.

reasons.title: Bangkok from indoors and out
reasons.text: Look over Bangkok from the indoor deck on Floor 74 and outdoor deck on Floor 78. Changing the space you view from adds variety even when the city is the same. Explore the decks with family or friends and look for features in the skyline.

reasons.title: The city beneath a glass floor
reasons.text: The glass floor 310 m above the ground is a distinctive experience here. Look down with a companion who enjoys heights. If it feels uncomfortable, focus on the broader city views instead of forcing yourself onto the glass.

mahanakhon-skywalk.recommended: For families and friends who enjoy skyline views, or photographers who want to see Bangkok from above. If a companion finds the glass floor uncomfortable, enjoy the attraction in a way that feels right for each of you.
mahanakhon-skywalk.entrance: From the ground-floor main entrance and ticket counter, have your ticket checked, pass through the photo area and digital corridor, then take the elevator to Floor 74. Floor 75 is the boarding area for the glass elevator to the upper levels.
faq: Is this the same as Sky Beach bar?

They share a building, but SkyWalk is an indoor and outdoor observation attraction. Choose a SkyWalk admission ticket for city views and the glass floor. Tickets and the purpose of a visit are separate from a bar visit.
Which ticket should I choose?
Use the official ticket page to choose the visit date, time slot and age category. Child tickets cover ages 8–12, so choose the correct age for a family visit.
How do I get there by train?
Leave BTS Chong Nonsi on the Silom Line through Exit 3 and head to King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Follow signs for the first-floor ticket counter and viewing-deck elevators.
Which floors can I visit?
You can see the indoor deck on Floor 74 and outdoor deck on Floor 78. Leave time for both to enjoy the city from different spaces.

access.name: BTS Chong Nonsi
access.instructions: From BTS Chong Nonsi Exit 3 on the Silom Line, head to King Power Mahanakhon’s main entrance. Prepare your ticket at the ground-floor counter and follow signs for the viewing-deck elevators.

baiyoke-observatory.name: Baiyoke Sky Observatory
baiyoke-observatory.building: Baiyoke Sky Hotel · Floor 77 observation deck · Floor 84 revolving observation deck
baiyoke-observatory.intro: After shopping in Pratunam, head up to Baiyoke Sky Observatory for another view of Bangkok. The hotel has a viewing area on Floor 77 and a revolving observation deck on Floor 84. It fits naturally after shopping with friends or a companion who enjoys city panoramas. Add time for the observatory when you want more from the day than shopping alone.

facts.hours: Daily 10:00–22:00; hours may change during long holidays.
facts.entryFee: Official special promotion: 450 baht net, including one drink at the Floor 83 rooftop bar.
facts.address: 222 Soi Ratchaprarop 3, Ratchaprarop Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400

reasons.title: Floor 77 and the revolving deck on Floor 84
reasons.text: Explore the two viewing floors and look across Bangkok. The revolving deck on Floor 84 is a distinctive feature. Take in the city from above with your companions.

reasons.title: Add a view to your Pratunam shopping day
reasons.text: If you plan to shop around Pratunam, add the observatory to the same day. Talk about your finds with friends and finish the day looking out across the city.

baiyoke-observatory.recommended: Visit with shopping friends in Pratunam or companions who enjoy city panoramas. It suits adding an observation-deck visit to a shopping day.
faq: Which floors have views?
You can visit the viewing area on Floor 77 and revolving observation deck on Floor 84. An observatory visit is distinct from simply going to the rooftop bar for a drink.
Does the ticket include a drink?

The official special promotion recorded in this guide costs 450 baht net and includes one drink at the Floor 83 rooftop bar. Because it is a special offer, check that the same package is available on your date before buying.
Can I go after shopping?
Opening hours are daily from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. Plan to continue from shopping in Pratunam to the observatory. Hours may change during long holiday periods.

access.instructions: For a car journey, open the directions below to check the building’s location. Set the destination to Baiyoke Sky Hotel and show the driver both its name and address.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep Viewpoint
doi-suthep-viewpoint.building: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep · Viewpoint within the temple grounds
doi-suthep-viewpoint.intro: Head to Doi Suthep for Chiang Mai’s temple architecture and views over the city. At the hilltop temple, explore the golden chedi and Lanna architecture, then look over Chiang Mai from the terrace. Come with parents or friends who enjoy temples, take your time walking and photographing the details, and pause to enjoy the view.

facts.address: Huai Kaeo Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai

reasons.title: See the golden chedi, then look over the city
reasons.text: After admiring the golden chedi and Lanna architecture, walk to the terrace. Chiang Mai below offers a different perspective from exploring its streets. A companion who enjoys temple buildings can combine architecture with a city view.

reasons.title: Climb beside the naga sculptures
reasons.text: The 306 steps flanked by naga sculptures are part of the visit. Walk up slowly with your companions and examine the carving. A cable car is an alternative if the steps are difficult. With parents or children, choose the ascent that suits everyone’s energy.

doi-suthep-viewpoint.recommended: Come with parents or friends who enjoy both temple architecture and city views. Explore the golden chedi, then pause on the terrace over Chiang Mai. This is a temple viewpoint, so plan time to see the grounds rather than expecting a drinks bar.
doi-suthep-viewpoint.entrance: At the temple approach, climb the 306 naga-lined steps or take the cable car. If you choose the steps, take your time looking at the sculptures. Once inside the temple, follow signs to the viewing area.
faq: Who is Doi Suthep good for?

It suits parents or friends who enjoy temple architecture as well as city views. After seeing the golden chedi, pause on the terrace overlooking Chiang Mai. Plan a temple visit: this is a viewing space within the grounds, rather than a bar where you order drinks.
Do I have to climb the stairs?

No, a cable car is another option. Choose the 306 steps if you want to see the naga sculptures on foot, or the cable car if a companion finds a long climb difficult. At the top, explore the architecture on the way to the terrace.
How do I go by songthaew?

Red songthaews in Chiang Mai can take you to Doi Suthep temple. Before boarding, agree on whether the trip goes all the way to the temple, whether it is one-way or round-trip and the total fare. Planning the return too makes it easier to continue your day after the view.
Is the map pin the viewing terrace?
The map shows the temple complex. On arrival, use the stairs or cable car, then follow local signs to the terrace. Enjoy the temple buildings as you walk toward the viewing space.

access.name: Red songthaew
access.instructions: Before boarding a red songthaew, agree that it goes to Doi Suthep temple, whether the journey is one-way or round-trip and the total fare. With parents or children, arrange your return before leaving too. At the temple approach, choose the stairs or cable car.

sky-bar.name: Sky Bar by lebua
sky-bar.intro: For cocktails overlooking Bangkok at night, head up to Sky Bar by lebua. The outdoor bar beside the golden dome looks over the Chao Phraya River and the city lights. If you are visiting with friends who have seen The Hangover Part II, try its film-linked Hangovertini. It suits an evening enjoying Bangkok after dinner with your companions.

facts.children: Children age 7 and older may enter with an adult.
facts.dressCode: Smart casual; no men’s sleeveless tops, sportswear, swimwear or flip-flops.
facts.address: 64th Floor, State Tower Bangkok, 1055 Silom Road, Bangrak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
facts.booking: Walk-ins only; reservations are not accepted.

reasons.title: River and city beside the golden dome
reasons.text: Look over the Chao Phraya River and central Bangkok from the outdoor bar. With the golden dome beside you, enjoy a panorama of the illuminated city. Talk about your trip with friends or spend an evening watching the lights with your partner.

reasons.title: A film connection in a Hangovertini
reasons.text: The Hangovertini is the bar’s cocktail associated with The Hangover Part II. With friends who know the film, recall familiar scenes and add another memory to your Bangkok trip.

sky-bar.recommended: For an evening of cocktails with friends who have seen The Hangover Part II, or a partner who enjoys skyline views.
sky-bar.bestTime: Arrive before sunset to see the city and sky in daylight, then watch Bangkok fill with lights after dark.

It is a good choice for an anniversary with a partner or a special dinner for your parents. Dining beneath the golden dome with Bangkok’s lights below creates an evening to remember with your companions. Choose a night when you do not need to rush elsewhere after dinner.
When can I hear live jazz?

Visit Tuesday through Sunday for live jazz alongside dinner and city views. Monday has background music instead of a live performance. Ask for the performance time when booking to help choose your dinner time.
Can I bring children?

Yes, children of all ages can join a family meal. Dress them in neat clothes rather than sportswear or flip-flops. If you plan to visit another bar in the same building afterward, remember that each bar can have a different minimum age.
What should I wear?

Think of clothes you would wear for a nice dinner out. Men can choose a shirt or polo with neat pants and loafers; women can wear a dress or blouse with a skirt or pants. Smart shorts and dressy sandals are permitted, so a suit or heels are not essential. Sportswear, swimwear and flip-flops are prohibited, and men cannot wear sleeveless tops.
How do reservations and cancellations work?

Choose a time using the official booking link once you have your date and companions. The deposit is credited toward your meal, and the reservation is confirmed after payment is received. Special event dates and groups have different refund terms.

Yes, but being open until 12:30 a.m. does not mean all food is available until then. Set menus close at 11 p.m., à la carte orders at 11:30 p.m. and snacks at midnight. If you want a leisurely course dinner, book earlier so you have time for both the meal and the views.
Can I bring luggage or large shopping bags?

No. Large bags, luggage and shopping bags are not allowed, and there is no storage. After shopping or sightseeing, return to your accommodation to leave bags and change before dinner. If you are visiting after checking out, arrange somewhere to keep your luggage during the meal.

reasons.title: A pause for sea views between sightseeing
reasons.text: This is an outdoor viewpoint rather than a rooftop bar for food and drinks. Add a short visit after sightseeing in Pattaya to look over the sea. A car journey up the hill can reduce walking in hot weather.

reasons.title: Plan the way back after sunset
reasons.text: Staying around sunset lets you enjoy changing colors over the city and water. Since it is outdoors, do other activities first on a rainy day and visit after the weather clears. Arrange return transport ahead if you plan to leave after dark.

faq: What can I see?
Look down over Pattaya Beach’s curve and the city behind it. It suits photographing sea and city from an angle different from the beach.
Is it a rooftop bar?
No, it is an outdoor hilltop viewpoint. Unlike a hotel rooftop bar for dinner or cocktails, it suits scenery and travel photographs.
When should I visit?
Visit in daylight for a clear daytime view of city and sea, or around sunset to stay into the evening lights. Because it is outdoors, waiting for rainy weather to clear makes viewing easier.
How do I get there?
Search for Phra Tamnak Mountain Viewpoint in Grab or Bolt. Going up the hill by car can reduce the walking effort. Arrange your ride down too if visiting at sunset.

phi-phi-viewpoint-2.name: Phi Phi Don Viewpoint 2
phi-phi-viewpoint-2.building: Ko Phi Phi Don — hillside viewpoint
phi-phi-viewpoint-2.intro: Head to Viewpoint 2 for a panorama of Phi Phi Don’s sea and island village. From the hillside, the island looks different from the beach below. Come with landscape-loving friends or when you want photographs to remember your stay. Leave time to look across the water and village rather than turning back after a quick glimpse, and enjoy Phi Phi Don at an unhurried pace.

reasons.title: See the island above beach level
reasons.text: Look down over sea and village from the hill. See the same water from above and notice how the village sits within the island. It suits a day when you want another perspective on Phi Phi Don.

reasons.title: Bring a friend who enjoys landscape photography
reasons.text: Come if you want travel photographs with sea and island village behind you. Take photos for each other, then put the camera down and pause for the view. Choose a day when you can enjoy the scenery together without rushing the journey or visit.

phi-phi-viewpoint-2.recommended: For travelers who want to see sea and village from above, or friends who enjoy landscape photography. As a hillside viewpoint, plan time for both getting there and enjoying the scenery.
faq: Who should I visit with?
Bring friends who enjoy landscape photography or companions who want to see the island from above. Take travel photographs for each other and spend time looking across the sea and village together.
What can I see at Viewpoint 2?
You can look down over Phi Phi Don’s sea and village. Seeing the beach scenery again from above and understanding the island’s shape is part of the appeal.
Which viewpoint does the map show?
The pin marks Phi Phi Don Viewpoint 2. Among the island’s different viewing points, use the name Viewpoint 2 when finding your destination.
Is it used like a rooftop bar?
It is an outdoor hilltop viewing point. Its purpose differs from a hotel rooftop serving food or drinks. Plan time for sea and village views and photographs.
